title: Nonvanishing of a balanced threshold form
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on sign vectors of length $n$, and let $a\in\mathbb{R}^n$. Suppose the mean of the real-valued version of $f$ on the uniform sign cube is zero, and $f(x)$ equals the threshold sign of $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$ for every $x$. Then $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i\ne 0$ for every sign vector $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on sign vectors of length $n$
the mean of the real-valued version of $f$ is zero
$f$ agrees everywhere with the threshold sign of the indicated linear form
